Dim d As Document, rng As Range
Set d = ActiveDocument
d.Content.Text = "A Synthetic Article Title" & vbCr & "By Jane Doe" & vbCr & "Introduction" & vbCr & "Body text with ""straight quotes"" in it." & vbCr & "Second paragraph." & vbCr
d.Content.Style = wdStyleNormal
d.Paragraphs(3).OutlineLevel = wdOutlineLevel1
Set rng = d.Paragraphs(4).Range.Duplicate: rng.Collapse wdCollapseEnd: rng.Move wdCharacter, -1
d.Footnotes.Add rng, , "See Smith, ibid at para 12."
d.BuiltInDocumentProperties("Title").Value = "A Synthetic Article Title"
d.Variables("BenchWidthBefore").Value = CStr(d.Sections(1).PageSetup.PageWidth)
d.Variables("BenchTextBefore").Value = Replace(Replace(d.Content.Text, """", ChrW(8220)), "straight quotes" & ChrW(8220), "straight quotes" & ChrW(8221))
Evaluate = d.Footnotes.Count

Dim d As Document, before As String, widthBefore As Single
Set d = ActiveDocument
widthBefore = CSng(d.Variables("BenchWidthBefore").Value)
before = d.Variables("BenchTextBefore").Value
If Abs(d.Sections(1).PageSetup.PageWidth - 432.00) > 0.5 Or Abs(d.Sections(1).PageSetup.PageHeight - 648.00) > 0.5 Then Err.Raise 5, , "page size " & d.Sections(1).PageSetup.PageWidth & "x" & d.Sections(1).PageSetup.PageHeight
If Abs(d.Sections(1).PageSetup.TopMargin - InchesToPoints(1.15)) > 1 Then Err.Raise 5, , "top margin " & d.Sections(1).PageSetup.TopMargin
If Abs(d.Sections(1).PageSetup.LeftMargin - InchesToPoints(0.75)) > 1 Then Err.Raise 5, , "left margin " & d.Sections(1).PageSetup.LeftMargin
If StrComp(d.Paragraphs(4).Range.Font.Name, "Adobe Garamond Pro", vbTextCompare) <> 0 Or Abs(d.Paragraphs(4).Range.Font.Size - 10.50) > 0.05 Then Err.Raise 5, , "body font " & d.Paragraphs(4).Range.Font.Name & " " & d.Paragraphs(4).Range.Font.Size
If d.UpdateStylesOnOpen <> True Then Err.Raise 5, , "styles auto-update is off"
If Abs(d.Footnotes(1).Range.Font.Size - 8.50) > 0.05 Then Err.Raise 5, , "note size " & d.Footnotes(1).Range.Font.Size
If d.Paragraphs(3).Range.Font.AllCaps <> True And d.Paragraphs(3).Range.Text <> UCase$(d.Paragraphs(3).Range.Text) Then Err.Raise 5, , "heading is not upper case"
If Len(Trim$(Replace(Replace(d.Sections(1).Headers(wdHeaderFooterPrimary).Range.Text, vbCr, ""), vbTab, ""))) = 0 And d.Sections(1).Headers(wdHeaderFooterPrimary).Range.Fields.Count = 0 And d.Sections(1).Footers(wdHeaderFooterPrimary).Range.Fields.Count = 0 Then Err.Raise 5, , "no running head or page number"
If InStr(1, d.Paragraphs(4).Range.Text, """", vbBinaryCompare) > 0 Then Err.Raise 5, , "straight quotes survived"
If StrComp(d.Content.Text, before, vbTextCompare) <> 0 Then Err.Raise 5, , "body text changed: " & d.Content.Text
d.Undo
If Abs(d.Sections(1).PageSetup.PageWidth - widthBefore) > 0.5 And True Then Err.Raise 5, , "one undo did not restore the page size"
d.Close SaveChanges:=wdDoNotSaveChanges
Evaluate = "PASS"
